semantic.justification: Iteration104 adapts the bounded ordinary SvxStyleBox client acceptance contract: direct picks and Enter resolve actual entries then focus the owning active Writer document before existing StyleApply dispatch; closed Arrow/Page travel is tentative, Tab accepts without focus release, Escape cancels and releases focus, and blur or replaced bindings/options invalidate drafts. Actual frame cursor/mark, raw custom names, history/no-op, document replacement and modal/inactive eligibility are covered by independent owned widget/frame tests and desktop/mobile ODT scenarios. Editable/new style creation, Clear/More actions, previews/context menus, full popup/platform behavior and wider native/widget/parent parity remain unverified. No status/default/exception promotion; registered save/open/recovery deviations unchanged. Task6764KT extracts the controller-neutral widget into VCL/browser ComboBox, preserving actual style lookup/acceptance and native focus contracts in this controller; optional row renderer and DOM overlay do not establish complete font/style visual parity. Task6764KT replaces the native-HTML font selector with the actual shared editable browser ComboBox. Direct picks and ordinary Enter release the owning Writer document/Calc grid before complete SvxFontItem acceptance; Tab accepts without explicit release, Escape restores the binding and sidebar Escape bubbles to its deck. Raw missing names are accepted without inventing installed rows. Font list enumeration refreshes retain an unchanged typed assignment through the common resetKey port; style option-owner changes still cancel stale drafts. Writer toolbar,Character panel focus entry and Calc workbench pass actual document focus owners. Glyph/cmap-dependent custom font row drawing,live preview/EndPreview owners,MRU/completion and full native platform behavior remain unfinished; no font/UI parity flag is promoted.
